notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
You control a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog that does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Retraction Helix.
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning The Great Henge from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.
